The clouds came, the wind was cold, and the children shivered, so when we got home they both went to bed crying, and now they have colds. I myself have a headache, and you yourself say, my stomach is not well? Had we remained in the village and waited for a day of sun it would have been all right. But we shall not do this again, we have learned that to bathe in the river when there are clouds and cold winds is not suitable. Wise people learn from the mistakes they make and don't do the same thing again.
